sources_note: 來源與日期逐篇列明。公司公告按原文歸因，開放範圍以可核對的資料為準。
sources_note_en: Each story lists its source and date. Company announcements are attributed and availability follows the documented scope.
thesis: 廣告、商品與量度工具更新，先核對預設及開放範圍
thesis_en: Check defaults and access as ad, commerce and measurement tools change
thesis_note: 10篇已覆核新聞，涵蓋廣告本地化、成效量度、社交電商及香港品牌展會。
thesis_note_en: 10 reviewed stories covering ad localization, measurement, social commerce and Hong Kong brand events.
sections: AI 大模型 & 市場動態
廣告平台 & 行銷科技
行業影響 & 品牌案例

items.title: ElevenLabs為廣告本地化加入人工覆核
items.title_en: ElevenLabs adds human review to ad localization
items.summary: Ads Engine可安排語言及創意專家審閱譯文、配音與品牌規範。
items.summary_en: Ads Engine can route translations, dubbing and brand checks to language and creative specialists.
highlights: 語言專家可檢查譯文語氣和品牌名稱發音。
完成的素材可交回團隊審批。
highlights_en: Language reviewers can check tone and brand-name pronunciation.
Finished assets can return to the team for approval.
items.why: 跨市場團隊可預先指定哪些廣告需要當地語言審閱，並把品牌把關與投放批准分開。
items.why_en: Cross-market teams can define which ads need local-language review and separate brand checks from launch approval.
items.next_step: 先選一支影片，提供品牌名稱讀音、禁用措辭及最終審批人。
items.next_step_en: Start with one video and supply brand pronunciations, restricted wording and a named approver.
items.detail: 公告把生成素材、專家審閱與發佈列為不同步驟。廣告主可用品牌規範及既有素材作審閱參考，並指定誰負責最終決定。公司提供聯絡入口，未在公告列出收費、服務時間或各市場資格。安排大批量製作前，宜先用一組素材核對譯文、發音與回稿流程，並記錄需要修改的地方。
items.detail_en: The announcement separates asset generation, specialist review and publishing. Teams can supply brand guidelines and existing assets. The release provides a contact form without listing fees, turnaround or market eligibility. Use one set of assets to check translation, pronunciation and the review handoff before expanding.

items.title: Google Analytics加入Data Manager測試版，集中檢視資料連線
items.title_en: Google Analytics adds a Data Manager beta for data connections
items.summary: 管理介面新增入口，讓團隊管理資料串流、產品連結及第一方資料。
items.summary_en: The admin hub manages streams, product links and first-party data.
highlights: 可從同一入口查看診斷提示與連線狀況。
Google說明列明子資源及匯總資源目前不支援該首頁。
highlights_en: The hub surfaces diagnostics and connection health.
Google says its landing page currently excludes subproperties and roll-up properties.
items.why: 量度團隊可較容易查找資料由何處進入，交接時也能更清楚說明連線由誰負責。
items.why_en: Measurement teams can trace data sources and clarify ownership during handoffs.
items.next_step: 先選一個可用的資源，整理連線清單與負責人，再逐項核對診斷。
items.next_step_en: Choose an eligible property and compare diagnostics with an inventory of connections and owners.
items.detail: 這次更新針對資料連線管理。Google把新入口放在管理介面，團隊可據此檢查資料串流及產品連結，並了解哪些項目需要跟進。測試版的使用範圍須以帳戶權限及資源類型確認。若報表出現異常，宜先比對現有設定與事件記錄，再決定是否改動資料來源或廣告匯入方式。
items.detail_en: The update is for managing data connections. Teams can review streams and product links and identify issues needing follow-up. Confirm property type and access before using the beta. For reporting anomalies, check existing setup and event records before changing data sources or ad imports.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技

items.title: 小紅書為線上「小紅卡」招募雙11合作商戶
items.title_en: Xiaohongshu recruits Singles’ Day merchants for its online Little Red Card
items.summary: 據億邦動力，線上會員年費為人民幣66元，商戶可按商品報名提供會員專享價。
items.summary_en: EBRUN reports an annual membership fee of RMB 66 and a programme for merchants to offer member pricing on selected items.
highlights: 今次招商面向站內電商，與早前本地生活會員安排有別。
報名商品可按活動安排提供會員價。
highlights_en: The recruitment concerns online commerce and is distinct from the earlier local-services membership.
Enrolled products can offer member pricing under the campaign terms.
items.why: 品牌可把會員折扣當作獨立促銷方案，按商品毛利評估能否長期維持。
items.why_en: Brands can evaluate member discounts as a separate promotion against product margins.
items.next_step: 先挑一款商品，計算會員價與其他優惠疊加後的毛利及退貨成本。
items.next_step_en: Start with one product and estimate margin and returns after combining eligible discounts.
items.detail: 報道把本次安排描述為雙11商戶招商。參與商戶可依活動規則選擇商品，讓會員以專享價購買。品牌需要先確認價格折扣由誰承擔、哪些優惠可以疊加，以及售後成本如何入帳。會員開卡費用與品牌促銷成本宜分開計算，再以實際訂單和回購觀察成效。分析時宜記下各次活動的折扣條件。
items.detail_en: The report describes merchant recruitment for Singles’ Day. Participants can choose items and offer members a dedicated price under programme terms. Confirm who funds discounts, which offers can stack and how returns are handled. Separate membership fees from promotion costs, then assess orders and repeat purchases. Record the discount terms for each campaign.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技

items.title: Meta廣告API v27調整商品展示及裝置擴展預設
items.title_en: Meta ad API v27 changes product showcase and device expansion defaults
items.summary: 據直接報道，新版本可為符合條件的廣告加入目錄商品，部分新銷售廣告組合亦會預設擴大裝置範圍。
items.summary_en: Direct reporting says eligible ads may gain catalogue products, and certain new Sales ad sets default to broader device reach.
highlights: 商品展示視乎目錄商品與廣告是否匹配，並有退出設定。
Graph API亦容許程式更新貼文的AI自我申報。
highlights_en: Product showcase depends on a catalogue match and can be opted out.
Graph API also allows apps to update AI self-disclosures on posts.
items.why: 透過代理商工具或自家程式建廣告的團隊，應核對省略設定時實際套用的預設。
items.why_en: Teams creating ads via agency or in-house tools should check what omitted settings actually do.
items.next_step: 用一個測試廣告組合比對送出的設定及讀回結果，記下裝置範圍和商品展示狀態。
items.next_step_en: Compare submitted and returned settings for one test ad set. Record device scope and product showcase status.
items.detail: PPC Land報道，Meta會在有把握找到匹配商品時，才可能為未設定商品展示的新廣告加入商品。裝置擴展則涉及指定裝置或作業系統的新銷售廣告組合。這些描述針對API，無法由此推定廣告管理介面的預設。貼文自我申報亦屬另一項設定，團隊仍應按自身的內容披露政策處理。
items.detail_en: PPC Land reports that Meta may add matched products to a new ad with no showcase setting. Device expansion concerns new Sales ad sets targeting particular devices or operating systems. The reporting covers the API and does not establish Ads Manager defaults. Handle the separate self-disclosure setting under the team’s disclosure policy.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技

items.title: Alexa購物助手加入短訊入口，先向部分美國顧客開放
items.title_en: Alexa for Shopping adds texting for invited US customers
items.summary: Amazon先以邀請方式開放短訊購物，可經文字比較商品、查訂單及提出購買要求。
items.summary_en: Amazon is starting with invitations. Text requests can cover product comparisons, order status and purchases.
highlights: 顧客可在短訊中查詢商品和訂單進度。
Amazon正逐步推出在短訊、網站及App延續同一對話的功能。
highlights_en: Shoppers can ask about items and deliveries by text.
Amazon is rolling out conversation continuity across text, app and web.
items.why: 當購物從對話開始，清楚的規格、價格與商品選項有助顧客比較。
items.why_en: Clear specifications, prices and variants help shoppers compare products in a conversation.
items.next_step: 抽查一組常見商品問題，核對商品頁能否提供準確的規格及款式資料。
items.next_step_en: Check common shopper questions against your product specifications and variant data.
items.detail: 這次變動是顧客可透過短訊使用購物助手，首階段限於部分獲邀的美國顧客。平台亦描述跨裝置延續購物對話的安排，開放程度仍須按帳戶確認。品牌可先從自身資料入手，檢查尺寸、容量、款式和售後條件是否容易比較，並把對話帶來的查詢與實際訂單分開觀察。兩類數字可分開設定報告欄位。
items.detail_en: Texting is the new entry point. Initial access is for invited US customers. Amazon also describes cross-device continuity as a rollout, so check access by account. Brands can audit sizes, capacities, variants and service terms and separate conversational enquiries from orders. Give the two measures separate reporting fields.
items.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態

items.title: MerchantFloor把商品圖與文案生成接入Shopify上架流程
items.title_en: MerchantFloor connects product image and copy generation to Shopify listings
items.summary: 商戶可上載商品照片和資料，先審閱生成結果，再送往Shopify管理介面。
items.summary_en: Merchants upload a photo and notes, review the results and send them to Shopify admin.
highlights: 工具可生成商品圖片、描述及搜尋欄位。
公司說明列明免費方案圖片附有浮水印。
highlights_en: The tool generates product images, descriptions and search metadata.
The company says free-tier images carry a watermark.
items.why: 小型電商可集中處理圖片與文案，仍可在匯入前核對商品細節。
items.why_en: Small stores can prepare images and copy together and check product facts before handoff.
items.next_step: 先挑一款外觀容易核對的商品，檢查圖片、尺寸、材質及替代文字。
items.next_step_en: Start with one item and check images, dimensions, materials and alt text.
items.detail: MerchantFloor把商品素材生成與上架交接連在一起。公告列出的輸出包括白底圖、生活場景圖、商品描述和圖片替代文字。商戶先確認和修改內容，再送到管理介面。對珠寶或具特定顏色的產品，可逐項比對原圖，尤其留意部件、材質及顏色有沒有被生成工具改動。
items.detail_en: MerchantFloor links asset generation to the listing handoff. Outputs include white-background and lifestyle images, descriptions and alt text. Merchants review and edit before sending them to Shopify. Check components, materials and colours against original photos, particularly for jewellery or colour-sensitive products.

items.title: 進博會香港食品館首設名牌專區，集中展示品牌故事
items.title_en: CIIE’s Hong Kong food pavilion debuts a dedicated brand zone
items.summary: 香港貿發局設食品及服務業兩個展館，食品館首次劃出香港名牌專區。
items.summary_en: The HKTDC mounted food and services pavilions. The food pavilion introduced a dedicated Hong Kong brand zone.
highlights: 據中新社，食品館有37家企業，展示食品及飲品。
服務業展館集合34家參展商，涵蓋企業服務及物流等領域。
highlights_en: China News Service reports 37 food and beverage exhibitors in the food pavilion.
The services pavilion gathered 34 exhibitors, including business services and logistics.
items.why: 香港品牌可把產品特色和品牌來源放在同一陳列，方便買家了解定位，再接續渠道洽談。
items.why_en: Hong Kong brands can show product features alongside their origins, then continue the conversation with channel buyers.
items.next_step: 為參展商品整理規格、供貨及渠道條件，按買家類型安排展後跟進。
items.next_step_en: Prepare specifications, supply and channel terms and organise follow-up by buyer type.
items.detail: 中新社的現場報道舉出傳統餅家、醬園，以及把鹹檸七元素放入拉格啤酒的品牌，展示名牌專區如何同時容納歷史與新產品。食品館與服務業展館的參展數按企業計算，與整個進博會的港企總數口徑不同。展商可按零售、分銷或服務合作分類跟進，並保留買家對供貨與定價的實際問題。
items.detail_en: China News Service describes traditional bakeries, sauce makers and a lager inspired by salted lemon soda. Pavilion exhibitor counts differ from the total number of Hong Kong companies at CIIE. Classify retail, distribution and service leads separately and capture actual buyer questions on supply and pricing.

items.title: Unbounce公布AI混合編輯器，可由提示詞、範本或空白頁起稿
items.title_en: Unbounce announces a hybrid AI builder with prompts, templates or blank pages
items.summary: 新工具把落地頁生成、手動編輯及測試放在同一流程，新自助帳戶會使用該編輯器。
items.summary_en: The builder combines generation, manual editing and testing. New self-serve accounts use it.
highlights: 團隊可修改生成初稿，也可直接使用範本或拖放元件。
官方說明指既有帳戶的頁面與編輯器暫時維持原狀。
highlights_en: Teams can edit AI drafts or start from templates or drag-and-drop components.
Official documentation says existing accounts retain their pages and builder for now.
items.why: 團隊可按任務選擇起稿方式，並保留對優惠文案、表單及量度設定的控制。
items.why_en: Teams can choose how to start while retaining control over offers, forms and measurement.
items.next_step: 先用一個有清楚轉化目標的活動，比對版面、表單及事件是否按預期運作。
items.next_step_en: Test one campaign with a defined conversion goal and verify layout, form and event behaviour.
items.detail: 公告所說的混合方式，是讓行銷人員在生成與手動編輯之間選擇。官方文件另說明新自助帳戶與現有帳戶的安排，所以準備測試前宜先查自己的編輯器版本。若同一活動要比較兩個落地頁，應固定主要受眾與優惠，再單獨比較一項改動，並先確認表單和轉化事件有記錄。測試前宜先定義合格名單的條件。
items.detail_en: Hybrid means marketers can choose between generation and manual editing. The docs distinguish new self-serve from existing accounts, so confirm builder access first. For a page test, keep audience and offer fixed, isolate one change and verify form submissions and conversion events. Define what counts as a qualified lead before testing.

items.title: 香港美酒展閉幕，業界買家與公眾試飲分設入口
items.title_en: Hong Kong wine fair closes after separate trade and public experiences
items.summary: 香港貿發局稱，展會吸引來自66個國家及地區的逾8,200名業界買家。
items.summary_en: The HKTDC reports more than 8,200 trade buyers from 66 countries and regions.
highlights: 主展期於11月7日結束。
最後一日設公眾專區，安排試飲及活動。
highlights_en: The fair ended November 7.
The final day offered a public zone with tastings and activities.
items.why: 酒類品牌可把分銷商洽談與消費者體驗分開設計，為兩種對象準備不同素材。
items.why_en: Wine brands can plan separate distributor meetings and consumer experiences, with different materials for each audience.
items.next_step: 分開整理買家跟進名單及試飲反饋，逐項確認有興趣的產品及渠道。
items.next_step_en: Separate buyer follow-ups from tasting feedback and record which products and channels drew interest.
items.detail: 貿發局在閉幕後公布買家人數，另列公眾日到場情況。兩組人數對應不同參與目的，品牌可按場景設計工作流程。買家會面可記錄分銷地區、供貨條件及樣品要求，公眾活動則可整理試飲偏好與常見查詢。下一步應以後續洽談或訂單衡量成果，保留原本的參與人數作背景。
items.detail_en: The organiser reported trade buyers separately from public attendance. Those groups have different purposes. Capture distribution markets, supply terms and sample requests in trade meetings, and log preferences and common questions during tastings. Use follow-up or orders to measure outcomes, with attendance as context.

items.title: 工具補讀：Meigen AI提示詞庫加入17個影片範例
items.title_en: Creative reference: Meigen AI adds 17 video prompt examples
items.summary: 更新日誌列出20個新增項目，當中17個是影片提示詞，另有3個圖片提示詞。
items.summary_en: The changelog lists 20 new entries, including 17 video prompts and three image prompts.
highlights: 新增範例涵蓋時裝分鏡、微型食物與光線變化。
平台表示保留來源貼文的創作者標註。
highlights_en: Examples cover fashion panels, miniature food and lighting changes.
Meigen says it retains original creator attribution.
items.why: 創意團隊可用範例比較不同鏡頭指令如何寫入簡報，並建立自己的指令結構。
items.why_en: Creative teams can compare how shot instructions are written and build their own brief structure.
items.next_step: 挑一個構圖例子，保留鏡頭和光線描述，換成品牌有權使用的參考素材。
items.next_step_en: Pick one composition and apply its camera and lighting structure to brand-authorised references.
items.detail: 這次是提示詞庫新增內容。團隊可拆開觀察主體、鏡頭、光線與動作如何描述，再用自家素材重寫其中一段。公開貼文與作者標註可協助追溯來源，商用前仍應確認素材與示例輸出的使用條件。即使採用相同的指令結構，也宜保存生成版本及修改紀錄，方便與同事比較結果。
items.detail_en: The update adds library entries. Study subject, camera, lighting and movement separately, then rewrite a prompt for your own material. Public attribution helps trace the source. Check usage terms before commercial use and retain generation and revision records for team comparison.
